rd.resultsSub.en: Per ad, for the window shown. Each rate is compared with the benchmark next to it.
rd.resultsSub.zh: 按广告、按所示时间窗口统计。每项比率均与旁边的基准对比。

rd.demoNote.en: Simulated for the rehearsal: no ad was served and nothing was spent. Demo results count at half in the US launch priority score.
rd.demoNote.zh: 为排练而模拟：未投放任何广告，也没有花费。演示结果在美国发行优先级评分中按一半计入。

rd.benchWhy.en: An ad above both benchmarks is worth more spend; an ad below either is not. Benchmarks are Studio-wide, not tuned per company.
rd.benchWhy.zh: 两项基准都达到的广告值得追加预算；任一未达到则不值得。基准为全站统一，不按公司调整。

rd.totals.zh: 总花费 ${spend} · 展示 {impressions} · 观看 {views} · 点击 {clicks}

rd.decideSub.en: Read from the table above with the Studio-wide benchmarks; nothing here is a prediction.
rd.decideSub.zh: 由上表和全站基准得出；这里没有任何预测。

rd.winnerLine.en: Ad {n} met both benchmarks: hook hold {hold}% (≥ {bh}%), CTR {ctr}% (≥ {bc}%).
rd.winnerLine.zh: 广告 {n} 两项基准均达标：开场留存 {hold}%（≥ {bh}%），点击率 {ctr}%（≥ {bc}%）。

rd.missedLine.zh: 广告 {n} {what}未达标：开场留存 {hold}%，点击率 {ctr}%。

rd.noWinner.en: No ad met both benchmarks. Do not scale this round; test new ads first.
rd.noWinner.zh: 没有广告同时达到两项基准。不要追加本轮预算，先测试新的广告。

rd.nextSub.en: Each option creates round {n} as a new campaign with its own brief, ads and approvals. Nothing launches until it is approved and submitted again.
rd.nextSub.zh: 每个选项都会创建第 {n} 轮作为新的广告活动，有自己的简报、广告和审批。再次批准并提交前不会投放。

rd.scaleHint.en: Round {n} with ${budget} (3× this round), same audience, built around Ad {ad}.
rd.scaleHint.zh: 第 {n} 轮预算 ${budget}（本轮 3 倍），受众不变，围绕广告 {ad} 制作。

rd.moreHint.en: Round {n} with the same ${budget}: new ads around the best hypothesis.
rd.moreHint.zh: 第 {n} 轮预算不变（${budget}）：围绕最佳假设制作新广告。

rd.retryHint.en: Round {n} with the same ${budget}: new ads, new hypothesis, same audience.
rd.retryHint.zh: 第 {n} 轮预算不变（${budget}）：新广告、新假设、受众不变。

rd.stopHint.en: Keep this round as the record. Nothing else is created.
rd.stopHint.zh: 保留本轮记录，不再创建任何内容。

rd.analyticsLink.en: See attributable revenue in title analytics
rd.analyticsLink.zh: 在作品分析中查看可归因收入

rd.roundCreated.en: Round {n} created as a new campaign.
rd.roundCreated.zh: 已创建第 {n} 轮广告活动。

rd.editorOnly.en: Only reviewers and approvers can create the next round.
rd.editorOnly.zh: 只有审阅者和审批者可以创建下一轮。
